title: Baldcone
description: Remove hoods from orthocones from Prehistoric Nature
body:
Baldcone is the resource pack for [Prehistoric Nature](https://modrinth.com/mod/prehistoric-nature) (v63 or later), to make Paleozoic nautiloid appearances different. Operculum of Paleozoic nautiloids are controversial topic, since presumed structure is considered as operculum by some and mouthparts by others. While in the mod the interpretation that it had an operculum is accepted, this resource pack offers an alternative interpretation by removing the operculum and pinhole eyes. Please note that this does not indicate which interpretation is more correct.

Supported mobs:

-Basiloceras

-Cameroceras

-Deiroceras

-Endoceras

-Gonioceras

-Lituites

-Mooreoceras

-Orthoceras

-Phragmoceras

-Rayonnoceras

-Temperoceras

Haven't done for Aphetoceras (which requires remodel) and more nautilus-looking nautiloids.
